description.value: Grouse Grind Coffee Bar is a café within the Grouse Mountain resort in North Vancouver, named after the famous Grouse Grind hiking trail that draws thousands of visitors to the area. The resort also hosts the Grouse Bike Park — a lift-accessed mountain bike park — making this a natural stop for cyclists in the area. It sits within a busy outdoor recreation hub that includes gondola access, wildlife habitats, and multiple dining venues.
